# equalang-dsh-plugin
**English** · 简体中文
Website · Pricing · Developer docs · API keys
**Translate the file, keep the layout — inside DeepSeek Harness.** This plugin gives the DeepSeek Ha
rness (`dsh`) agent the tools of Equalang, an AI translator that works on whole files: a PDF comes b
ack as a PDF, a deck as a deck, with tables, images and formulas where they were. It also translates
subtitles and pictures, turns audio and video into translated subtitles or a transcript, and transl
tures, turns audio and video into translated subtitles or a transcript, and translates text in bulk.
The tools are the ones the Equalang MCP server offers every other agent. The plugin starts that serv
er with DeepSeek Harness's own runtime, so it works in the desktop app with no Node.js installed, an
d hands it your key.
## Try asking

- "Translate ~/Documents/contract.pdf into Chinese, keeping the layout."
- "Translate pitch-deck.ppt

x into Japanese and German."
- "How much would it cost to translate thesis.docx into French?"
- "Mak

e Korean subtitles for interview.mp4, with the original line above each one."
- "Transcribe standup.
m4a with timestamps."
## Install
In the DeepSeek Harness desktop app or web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter

and choose **Install**, then **Enable now**.
From a terminal, for `dsh web`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
then restart `dsh web`. Use the profile name you start dsh with; the desktop app keeps its own profi
le, so install there through its **Plugins** page.
Needs DeepSeek Harness 0.2. The desktop app brings everything else; the `dsh` command needs Node.js
24.9 or later, as dsh itself does.
## Your API key
Sign up at <https://equalang.com> and create a key at <https://equalang.com/api-keys>. New accounts
start with free credits, enough to put a document through.
The simplest place for it is `~/.config/equalang/.env`, the one file every Equalang integration read
s, so a key saved once for Claude Code, Codex or the Equalang skill works here too:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin looks in two places before that file, so a key there wins:
1. **The plugin's own setting**, `apiKey` on the `equalang` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
: `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (the profile is `web` for `dsh web` and `desktop` for
the desktop app), or `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` for every profile. Add the row to the list the file
pp), or `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` for every profile. Add the row to the list the file already holds:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
2. **`EQUALANG_API_KEY` wherever DeepSeek Harness looks for keys**: its credential store, the enviro
nment dsh was started from, or `~/.dsh/.env`.
DeepSeek Harness does not pass exported variables whose names look like credentials to the MCP serve
rs it starts, so the plugin hands the key over itself. A changed key takes effect without restarting
he plugin hands the key over itself. A changed key takes effect without restarting DeepSeek Harness.
## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `mcp__equalang__translate_file` | Translate a document, subtitle file, picture or recording, and s

ave the result beside it |
| `mcp__equalang__transcribe_recording` | Write down what a recording say

s, as timed text |
| `mcp__equalang__translate_text` | Translate strings, or one long text |
| `mcp_
_equalang__estimate_cost` | Upload a file and say the most a job on it can cost, without starting an

ything (free) |
| `mcp__equalang__check_job` | Collect a job that was still running when its call re

turned |
| `mcp__equalang__cancel_job` | Stop a job; a cancelled job costs nothing |
| `mcp__equalan

g__get_credit_balance` | The account's credits |
| `mcp__equalang__list_languages` | The language co
des Equalang takes |
Files are named by an absolute path or a public URL, and results are written beside the source witho
ut overwriting anything. A long file can take minutes: a call waits up to 50 seconds by default, the
n answers with a job id for `check_job`.
## Costs and privacy
- Jobs spend your Equalang credits, the same balance as on the website. `estimate_cost` is free. Dee
pSeek Harness runs MCP tools without asking you first, so the agreement comes from the model: the se
rver tells it to say the cost and get your agreement before a job. Credits are bought at <https://eq
ualang.com/pricing>. The model the agent runs on is billed separately, by DeepSeek or whichever prov

ider you chose.
- A file you ask to translate is uploaded to Equalang to be processed. See the priva

cy policy.
- Like every MCP server DeepSeek Harness starts, this one runs outside the agent's sandbo
x: it reads the file you name and writes its results beside it under any permission preset.
## Settings
On the `equalang` row of a profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, as shown above for the key. A change applie
s without a restart.
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `apiKey` | none | Your Equalang API key |
| `baseUrl` | `https://equalang.com/v1` | Another deploy

ment of the Equalang API |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `600000` | How long one tool call may run before
DeepSeek Harness gives up on it |
## Troubleshooting
- **No Equalang tools.** Check that the plugin is enabled under **Plugins**, and restart after insta
lling from a terminal. DeepSeek Harness refuses to install or start a plugin made for another versio

n of itself, and says which version it needs.
- **`EQUALANG_API_KEY is not set`.** Save the key in o

ne of the places above. An `export` in your shell alone does not reach the server.
- **Installed fro
m a terminal, missing in the desktop app.** `dsh plugin --profile web` installs into the `web` profi
le; the desktop app uses its own. Install through the app's **Plugins** page.
## Also from Equalang
- equalang-mcp, the MCP server this plugin runs, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP client

s.
- equalang-skill, the same operations as an Agent Skill. DeepSeek Harness also loads skills from

`~/.agents/skills`.
- The Equalang API: <https://equalang.com/llms.txt>
